## Highlights since 0.16.11

- **Linux AppImage is back.** v0.16.11 shipped without an AppImage; this release has one again. Its window now draws on Ubuntu 26.04, Fedora 45 and Arch instead of staying blank. Thanks to @stefanbringuier.
- **⌘W closes the terminal.** In the focused Terminal panel, ⌘W closes the terminal, not the document or window, and asks first if a command is still running. Thanks to @ajay-mk.

## Notable fixes

- The Terminal panel closes when its last shell exits. Thanks to @ajay-mk.
- Lint and the i18n guard run on Windows development setups. Thanks to @skytheacademic.
